library(rliger)
library(rhdf5)
library(HDF5Array)

# The script of online iNMF for diagonal integration, [RNA, ATAC] data type, ATAC needs to be coverted into gene activity score. The output is joint embedding (dimension reduction)
# run commond for online iNMF
# Rscript main_online_iNMF.Rmd  '../../data/dataset_final/D27/rna.h5' '../../data/dataset_final/D27/atac_gas.h5' '../../result/embedding/diagonal integration/D27/online_iNMF/'

# useful functions
h5_to_matrix <- function(path){
    h5_data <- h5read(path,"matrix") 
    feature <- h5_data$features
    barcode <- h5_data$barcodes
    data <- t(h5_data$data)
    colnames(data) <- as.character(barcode)
    rownames(data) <- as.character(feature)
    return (data)
}

write_h5 <- function(exprs_list, h5file_list) {
  if (length(unique(lapply(exprs_list, rownames))) != 1) {
    stop("rownames of exprs_list are not identical.")
  }
  for (i in seq_along(exprs_list)) {
    if (file.exists(h5file_list[i])) {
      warning("h5file exists! will rewrite it.")
      system(paste("rm", h5file_list[i]))
    }
    h5createFile(h5file_list[i])
    writeHDF5Array(((exprs_list[[i]])), h5file_list[i], name = "data")
    print(h5ls(h5file_list[i]))
  }
}

# wrap the iNMF method
runiNMF<- function(path_list){
  data <- vector("list", length(path_list))
  for (i in c(1:(num-1))){
    temp <- h5_to_matrix(path_list[[i]])
    colnames(temp) <- paste0(i, "_", 1:dim(temp)[2])
    data[[i]] <- temp
    names(data)[i] <- as.character(i)
  }
  pbmcs <- createLiger(data)
  pbmcs <- rliger::normalize(pbmcs)
  # do.call puts the value itself (not a variable name) into the call, as the literal did;
  # quote(pbmcs) keeps the object out of the call that rliger records
  pbmcs <- do.call("selectGenes", list(quote(pbmcs), var.thresh = thresh))
  pbmcs <- scaleNotCenter(pbmcs)
  # an option left at NULL is not passed, so rliger's own default applies
  pbmcs <- do.call("runIntegration", c(list(quote(pbmcs), k = k, method = "online"), given(lambda = lambda, maxEpochs = maxEpochs, minibatchSize = minibatchSize, seed = seed)))
  #pbmcs <- online_iNMF(pbmcs, k = 20, miniBatch_size = 5000, max.epochs = 5)
  pbmcs <- quantileNorm(pbmcs)
  result <- pbmcs@H.norm
  return (result)
}

# input
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
# Hyperparameters follow the paths as --name=value. A default is the value this script has
# always used; NULL leaves the argument to rliger.
is_opt <- grepl("^--[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.]*=", args)
opts <- setNames(sub("^--[^=]+=", "", args[is_opt]), sub("^--([^=]+)=.*", "\\1", args[is_opt]))
args <- args[!is_opt]
option <- function(name, default, convert = as.numeric) {
  if (!name %in% names(opts)) return(default)
  value <- suppressWarnings(convert(opts[[name]]))
  if (is.na(value)) stop("option --", name, ": cannot read the value ", opts[[name]])
  opts <<- opts[names(opts) != name]
  value
}
given <- function(...) Filter(Negate(is.null), list(...))
k <- option("k", 20)
lambda <- option("lambda", NULL)
maxEpochs <- option("maxEpochs", NULL)
minibatchSize <- option("minibatchSize", NULL)
seed <- option("seed", NULL)
thresh <- option("thresh", 0.2)
if (length(opts) > 0) stop("unknown option: ", paste0("--", names(opts), collapse = " "))
num <- length(args)
path_list <- vector("list", num-1)
for (i in c(1:(num-1))){
  path_list[[i]] <- args[i]
}
save_path <- args[num] 

# run method
begin_time <- Sys.time()
result <- runiNMF(path_list)
end_time <- Sys.time()
all_time <- difftime(end_time, begin_time, units="secs")

# save result
if (!dir.exists(save_path)) {
  dir.create(save_path, recursive = TRUE)
  print("path create")
}
print(dim(result))
print(all_time)
write.csv(rownames(result), paste0(save_path,"barcode.csv"))
write_h5(exprs_list = list(rna = result), 
             h5file_list = c(paste0(save_path,"embedding.h5")))
